notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Othelm.
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hornet Queen, adding {1}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Hornet Queen from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Insect tokens, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.
